questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: At 00:08-00:10, three distinct pen-like objects are visible on the white board.

While all three are vertical, the leftmost object shows a pointed tip at the bottom, whereas the middle and right objects have black caps at the bottom. They are not in the same state/orientation relative to their parts.
The middle and right pens have black caps at the bottom. The left pen has a translucent/grey tip at the bottom, indicating a color mismatch at the lower end.
The leftmost pen shows a bare writing tip (or appears to be a refill) at the bottom, while the other two are capped with black caps. It also appears slightly thinner/shorter at the bottom end.
The board moves smoothly from left to right throughout the entire clip without stopping or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their slots on the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The leftmost pen is uncapped (showing a bare tip/refill) while the other two pens are capped, violating the condition that all pens must be identical and capped.

description: One pen is missing its cap while the others are capped.
